mutation.engine: TypeScript5.9.2 AST transforms + Bun1.3.6 exact existing test runner, optional 1.4.1 compatibility
mutation.order: first-order, one edit per isolated candidate; dedup by original path/start/end/replacement SHA256; deterministic bytewise path then offset then operator then replacement ordering
mutation.scope: All executable owned production/tooling/test/fixture/benchmark TS/JS, including analyzer, test runner and mutation runner code. Type-only annotations, comments and nonexecuting data do not have runtime mutations; explicit type census mutation fixtures cover type keywords.

case literal: delete case clause including its statements

mutation.preconditions: Resolve method receiver type for array/string operators; never mutate module specifier strings, directives or type-only literals. Regex alternatives enumerate all applicable token positions. AST/no-op byte-identical edits are not eligible and record reason. All remaining generated edits get a manifest row even if compilation fails.

outcomes.KILLED: mutated program compiles, baseline is green, unchanged behavioral test asserts false or real gate discriminates mutant, recorded assertion identity; syntax/config/build crashes are not kills
outcomes.SURVIVED: eligible valid mutant executes its selection successfully
outcomes.NO_COVERAGE: valid mutant never reaches its original mapped location; blocking
outcomes.INVALID: generated mutant is rejected by parser/typecheck; retain full diagnostics and denominator, never count as KILLED
outcomes.INFRA_ERROR: process/signal/build/timeout/incomplete/missing output unrelated to a demonstrated behavioral assertion; blocking

mutation.fullPass: SURVIVED=0 AND NO_COVERAGE=0 AND INFRA_ERROR=0 AND all generated candidates classified AND all eligible files/operators accounted; nonzero valid mutants or a syntax-based proof of no eligible runtime site per file/operator; zero-file/zero-selection run fails
mutation.timeoutPolicy: Bound tests at 15000ms; timeout alone is INFRA_ERROR not a killed mutant. Subscribe to child exit/error before trigger; deterministic fault signals, no fixed sleeps/polling.
mutation.smallPR: full non-mutation gates and discriminating synthetic mutation fixtures; optional changed-unit mutation explicitly partial; never claim full zero
mutation.cachePolicy: Reuse only identical source/tree/contract/inventory/operator/tool/test hashes with complete immutable raw receipts; full manifest is still enumerated, no baseline/survivor suppression
mutation.testMutationCaveat: Surviving weakened test assertions are blockers. Feasibility is unverified, not an exclusion or a reason to reduce scope.

pythonSource.futureOwnedPythonScripts: Any added script/*.py analyzer/preload/helper files also included in owned inventory with same bounds; not a tool exemption
pythonSource.dependencyLock: script/conformance/quality-python-requirements.lock: exact versions with hashes for full transitive resolution on CPython3.12.12; parent lock sha required before implementation integration, not generated here

metrics.cyclomatic: radon6.0.1 visitors over file AST, max21 per function/method/module executable body; nested functions separately
metrics.cognitive: cognitive_complexity.api.get_cognitive_complexity@1.3.0 per function; synthetic function wrapper for module top-level control, max21; no wrapper-induced increment
metrics.halstead: radon6.0.1 h_visit h1/h2/N1/N2 and difficulty, unrounded difficulty<80 per function/module; JSON records raw counts
metrics.CRAP: same formula and strict<25 using radon C and same function original-source statement coverage

pythonSource.clones: same jscpd4.0.5 weak mode50tokens5lines with python format, driver.py included as a production file

coverage.engine: coverage.py7.10.7 branch=True, timid=True to avoid platform-extension variation, concurrency=thread; all sources pre-registered; exclude_lines=[] and partial_branches=[] (no default pragma exclusions)
coverage.statementDimension: d945-python-coverage@1 AST statement-entry counters, including separate same-line statements; no comments/docstrings/type-only constructs counted as executable statements; function-body counters distinct from definition execution
coverage.functionDimension: AST function/lambda entry counter, preserving signatures and coroutine/generator semantics; unexecuted function0, cannot credit definition line alone
coverage.lineDimension: coverage.py executable source lines (no excludes); unknown/unloaded driver.py remains0 not omitted
coverage.branchDimension: coverage.py full static possible arcs for branch lines, all exits required; short-circuit operand decision counters added by d945-python-coverage@1 for each BoolOp transition, preserving single evaluation
coverage.thresholds: all four dimensions100 per Python file and aggregate; same no-rounding/missing-data policy as TS
coverage.processSurface: historical TypeScript driver instrumentation; the Rust client now owns driver.py and its subprocess, so this obsolete probe is not an active coverage receipt
coverage.liveness: killed/crashed driver trace missing => incomplete, not0success; use bounded exact command/exit signals, no sleeps/polls

mutation.orderAndOutcomes: same first-order stable original-source identity and KILLED/SURVIVED/NO_COVERAGE/INVALID/INFRA_ERROR definitions as JS; invalid syntax not killed, no equivalents allowlist
mutation.runner: TS mutation coordinator replaces exactly one candidate in an isolated driver.py copy, probes the Python site and runs the selected tests; no static fake Python execution

pythonSource.binaryConformance: The Python worker parses driver.py source, enumerates AST mutation sites and instruments selected sites with markers; the coordinator mutates an isolated file copy, runs selected tests and verifies restoration. This does not establish Rust client driver coverage, clone detection or metric thresholds.
